name: twilio
description: Look up the official Twilio communications platform — search and retrieve any of 1,800+ Twilio API endpoints across 30+ products, plus Twilio, SendGrid, and Segment docs, via the hosted Twilio MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Search and retrieve the official Twilio API reference and docs.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can look up the official Twilio API documentation — searching across 1,800+ endpoints across 30+ products including SMS, Voice, WhatsApp, Verify, and more. Whenever you need to know the right API endpoint, parameters, or authentication for a Twilio integration, your agent can find it instantly. No more bookmarking docs pages or guessing API schemas.
defaultPrompt: Find me the Twilio API endpoint for sending an SMS message.
Look up how to verify a phone number with Twilio Verify.
Search the docs for how to set up WhatsApp messaging.
